target_customer: Ultra high net worth individuals seeking off market luxury goods and services
problem: Wealthy buyers cannot easily find trusted off market experiences and services.

founders.name: Rey Flemings
previous_startups: The Blue (off market services firm, bootstrapped to $16M GMV per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: 11 years in a family office, 8 with Justin Timberlake; says Particle was acquired by Apple in 2012. A second co-founder is unnamed.

defensibility.rationale: Vetted membership and relationships are hard to copy, though the product is mostly services.

market_need_then: Launch press release March 2022 limited to 1,000 members with KYC checks; no spend data.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by SF Standard, Hollywood Life and Private Banker International per search listings

brand_strength.rationale: Exclusivity framing and press coverage, but little detail opened.

outcome_analysis: Myria launched in March 2022 with a 1,000 member cap and remains active. A reported $20M Series B in 2025 appears only on PitchBook, so it is unverified. Funding totals conflict widely across aggregators.
notes: myria.us redirects to the.blue. Unverified funding: Seedtable $4M seed led by Backend Capital (Aug 2022), Preqin and Dealroom $1.6M, CB Insights $500K, PitchBook $20M Series B Oct 2025 and $24.8M total. Competitor search returned 2019 and 2025 era pages naming Quintessentially and Velocity Black, not tied to the batch, so the list is empty.
